name: Sealed Note to Elling
summary: The Sealed Note to Elling is a confidential dispatch penned by the Stormwind fisherman Jorgen. Intended for Elling Trias, the proprietor of Trias' Cheese, it serves as an early link in the discreet investigation surrounding a vanished diplomat.

sections.title: A Quiet Hand-Off
sections.body: Carrying a sealed note through the bustling avenues of Stormwind might seem mundane, but Jorgen's strict instructions make the stakes clear: deliver the parchment into Elling Trias's hands and keep silent. While Trias outwardly presents himself as a mild-mannered cheese merchant in the Trade District, this clandestine message directs the investigation of the missing diplomat straight to his counter, hinting at networks far deeper than dairy trade.

faq.q: What is written inside the sealed note?
faq.answer: The note remains sealed until handed to Elling Trias. It contains Jorgen's report and an introduction directing the courier to Trias for deeper inquiries into the diplomat's disappearance.

faq.q: Why does a cheese vendor receive secret intelligence?
faq.answer: Elling Trias maintains an unassuming cheese shop in the Trade District as a public front. Beneath the apron, Trias possesses an extensive underground network of ears and eyes across the city, making him an invaluable asset for delicate investigations.

Jorgen is a fisherman found down by the water in Stormwind's Valley of Heroes. He has some kind of history with Elling Trias and Bishop DeLavey, and the bishop calls on him for discreet matters kept away from prying eyes.

faq.q: What is the missing diplomat case about?
faq.answer: The kingdom is on edge following the unexplained vanishing of an envoy sent on a critical peace mission, and royal authorities are quietly investigating every suspicious lead without causing panic in the streets.

angles.text: Rogues familiar with Stormwind's shadow networks recognize Elling Trias as far more than a merchant of cheddar, making this discreet correspondence an unsurprising piece of tradecraft.
Carrying Jorgen's message is a direct service to the Crown, advancing an investigation critical to the political stability of Stormwind.
